## Task 2: Scree plot and variance explained

```{r task2-scree}
# TODO: compute Proportion of Variance Explained (PVE) for each PC
# PVE_k = pca$sdev[k]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
pve <- NULL  # pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

tibble(PC = 1:length(pve), PVE = pve, cumPVE = cumsum(pve)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC, y = PVE)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(aes(y = cumPVE), colour = "red", group = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cumPVE), colour = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot — Insurance Policyholders",
       y = "Proportion of Variance Explained",
       caption = "Red line = cumulative PVE") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r task2-80pct}
# TODO: how many PCs are needed to explain at least 80% of variance?
# Hint: use cumsum(pve) >= 0.80
num_pcs_80 <- NULL  # min(which(cumsum(pve) >= 0.80))
cat("Number of PCs for 80% variance:", num_pcs_80, "\n")
```
